description: Distinctive fake-secret markers ('canaries') that the redaction tests inject. They are intentionally fake and are NEVER real credentials. The secret-canary sweep fails CI if the CANARY- marker (or any known value) appears in a shipped artifact, generated output, or the built dashboard bundle — proving redaction never leaks a secret into logs, fixtures, or diagnostics (FR-OBS-03; NIC-69 AC-7; NIC-34 AC-34.1).
note: The Swift redaction/disclosure tests under Tests/ are the source of these values. The marker prefix is what the sweep detects, so a new CANARY- value added to a test is covered automatically; keep knownCanaries in sync for documentation and gitleaks allowlisting.
